title: tooling(census): `census:cross-file-line-citations` refuses every run on main — its `non-firing` control is itself a rotted citation
body:
Found while working objectui#9026 (the continuation-parser card). ⛔ Not caused by that change — measured on clean `main` **before** any edit, and byte-identical after it.

## Reproducer

```
$ git checkout main   # measured at 3984bab5a
$ node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs
...
✗ 1 control(s) failed -- this run is NOT a reading.
$ echo $?
1
```

The failing control, verbatim from the run:

```
FAIL  non-firing (want not-false): packages/types/src/crud.ts -> packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx
      packages/types/src/crud.ts:53  -> packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:387 [anchor-absent];
      packages/types/src/crud.ts:348 -> packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:387 [drifted]
      why: the cited line is the `ComponentRegistry.register('detail',` call the prose names
```

## The mechanism

`CONTROLS`' `non-firing` entry is addressed by FILE PAIR, and `evaluateControls` takes **every** row matching that pair, then requires that none of them be false. `crud.ts` names that same address in **two** places — once in the `type: 'action'` epitaph and once in the `crud-dialog` one — both writing the same number for the `register('detail'` call. One of the two is now judged `drifted`, so `anyFalse` is true and the control fails.

⇒ The control is doing its job: the address it is pinned on has rotted. What is broken is the consequence — the instrument now refuses **every** reading of itself.

## Why it matters

⭐ This is the census the whole objectui#8875 family reads for "the number", and it has been answering `exit 1 / NOT a reading` rather than a number. The failure is the quiet kind: a seat that runs it gets a refusal rather than a wrong answer, so nothing is falsely reported — but nobody can take a reading either, and objectui#9026 had to take its own backlog measurement as a row-set **delta** between two runs of the same refused instrument, with a separate faithfulness control, precisely because the absolute run would not certify itself.

⚠️ It is also the exact defect class the census exists to measure, arriving inside the census's own control — the same shape as objectui#9026's card carrying an address that does not resolve.

## What is owed, and the choice that has to be made rather than assumed

Clause 4 of objectui#8875's ruling repairs an address by converting it to a CONTENT anchor, ⛔ never by moving the number to a different number. So:

1. repair both `crud.ts` sites to anchor by content, and re-pin the control on something a content anchor can hold; **or**
2. keep a line-addressed control but make it match ONE citation rather than a file pair, so a second, unrelated citation to the same file cannot sink it.

⚠️ Not measured here: whether option 2 leaves the control able to fire at all, and whether any other `CONTROLS` entry is exposed to the same two-rows-one-pair shape.

## Not in scope of objectui#9026

That card owns the continuation PARSER. This is judge/control-side, lands on `packages/types/src/crud.ts` (a published package's prose) rather than on `scripts/`, and repairing it is a prose judgement rather than a mechanical edit — so it was filed rather than ridden in.
